posts.t: Sennecke with the redirect in front, and the Flyers pay for that Gaucher penalty. 5-3 Ducks.
Gaucher gets nabbed for tripping in the neutral zone. The sloppiness since the 2nd period continues.
The Gaucher line (with Knuble and Barkey) has delivered some good early shifts. Forechecking well and winning pucks back.
